resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Swedish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Swedish pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, formula-notation, circuit, thermal, and SI-unit defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Swedish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Ohm's-law relationship heading was less natural than the Swedish technical term for a relationship.
evidence: The previous heading was Relationen.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Sambandet.

findings.summary: The rearranged-formulas heading used a literal Swedish construction.
evidence: The previous heading was Omarrangerade formler.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Omformade formler.

findings.summary: The zero-resistance warning used a spelled-out zero-unit phrase.
evidence: The previous text was Ett motstånd på noll Ω.
findings.resolution: Changed it to resistans på 0 Ω and retained the short-circuit warning.

findings.summary: The resistance example title used motstånd instead of the precise resistance term.
evidence: The previous title was Hitta motstånd.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Beräkna resistansen.

findings.summary: The voltage example title used an inconsistent imperative.
evidence: The previous title was Hitta spänning.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Beräkna spänningen.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating display name had an unnatural word break.
evidence: The previous name was Joule uppvärmning.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the compound technical term Jouleuppvärmning.

findings.summary: The constant-voltage bullet used an awkward noun phrase for lower resistance.
evidence: The previous text used Vid konstant spänning ökar sänkning av resistans.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as reduced resistance increasing heat power.

findings.summary: The Joule paragraph called electrical power a force and heat flow a general flow.
evidence: The previous paragraph began Elektrisk kraft är en hastighet av energiöverföring.
findings.resolution: Corrected it to electrical power and heat-flux density.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description omitted charge and energy as the conserved quantities.
evidence: The previous description referred generally to bevarande vid kretsnoder.
findings.resolution: Named charge conservation at nodes and energy conservation around closed loops.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms heading was translated as circuit conditions.
evidence: The previous heading was Kretsvillkor.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Kretstermer.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms introduction used a literal phrase meaning reason about a diagram.
evidence: The previous text used lättare att resonera kring.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as easier to interpret.

findings.summary: The KVL formula translated the protected parallel-branch note.
evidence: The previous expression ended with (parallella grenar).
findings.resolution: Restored the protected note (parallel branches).

findings.summary: The series-cell statement used an awkward phrase for equivalent cell capacity.
evidence: The previous sentence used kapaciteten i amperetimmar förblir den för en lika stor cell.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it using a corresponding individual cell.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell statement omitted the approximate proportional relationship.
evidence: The previous sentence ended with ökar ungefär.
findings.resolution: Clarified that capacity and available current increase approximately proportionally.

findings.summary: The resistor-equation bullet was less direct than standard Swedish technical wording.
evidence: The previous bullet used Relatera motståndets spänning och ström med.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as the relation V = I × R.

findings.summary: The TCR display name used motstånd instead of the precise resistans term.
evidence: The previous name was Temperaturkoefficient för motstånd (TCR).
findings.resolution: Changed it to Resistansens temperaturkoefficient (TCR).

findings.summary: The TCR unit explanation said temperatures use a scale instead of being expressed in one.
evidence: The previous bullet used Temperaturer måste använda samma skala och enheter.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to require expression in the same scale and units.

findings.summary: The negative-TCR warning used a literal phrase for reversing a prediction.
evidence: The previous bullet used vänder förutsägelsen.
findings.resolution: Clarified that taking the absolute value reverses the prediction.

findings.summary: The right-triangle explanation used literal and imprecise side descriptions.
evidence: The previous paragraph used a literal translation of opposite and adjacent side definitions.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the definitions with the SOH-CAH-TOA ratios.

findings.summary: The angle-mode guidance was less natural than Swedish technical instructions.
evidence: The previous paragraph used mode of correct angle and a literal vice-versa construction.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with natural Swedish wording for angle mode and a full turn.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity heading used relationer instead of the standard technical term samband.
evidence: The previous heading was Grundläggande relationer.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Grundläggande samband.

findings.summary: The water-heating setup used inconsistent numeric formatting for specific heat.
evidence: The previous setup used c = 4180 J/(kg·K).
findings.resolution: Changed it to c = 4 180 J/(kg·K) with consistent Swedish spacing.

findings.summary: The SI table heading called the entries common units rather than base units.
evidence: The previous heading was Vanliga SI-enheter.
findings.resolution: Changed it to SI-grundenheter.

findings.summary: The decimal-prefix heading lacked the normal Swedish adjective form.
evidence: The previous heading was Decimalprefix.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Decimala prefix.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge heading used the generic term measuring systems.
evidence: The previous heading was Mätsystem.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Kalibersystem.
